messages:
Tess Nguyen: Heads-up — assembling a small 'hotlist' preflight for 3 at-risk accounts before renewal next month. Need a short customer-facing checklist we can hand to their engs — focused on caching/prefixing, request batching, streaming toggles, and telemetry we should capture as renewal-risk signals. Any quick templates we can reuse?

Rafael Cruz: +1. Keep it super short. Suggest a 'quick perf triage' section: 1) check cache hit rate, 2) measure p95 with streaming vs non-stream, 3) validate batch_size and concurrency settings. One-pager should have fill-in fields.

Jun Park: I can draft. For streaming guidance: recommend enabling streaming when backend generation rounds > ~500ms. For low-latency single-token flows, prefer small batch_size (1-4). We should include recommended thresholds (p95 target < 400ms for interactive).

Emi Sato: Also include a tiny curl example to validate streaming + cache header. And a checkbox for whether they're using prefix caching or response caching. Customers often forget to tell us TTLs.

Tess Nguyen: Good call. Also capture renewal-risk signals: drop in MAU, sustained rise in error rate, repeated billing disputes, recent config toggles that increased latency, and any drop in SLA compliance. Those map to AM playbook actions.

cs_ops_bot: Reminder: use /capture-feedback hotlist-preflight to create a feedback ticket so AMs + SRE can correlate signals automatically.

Sarai Patel: Putting a compact customer-fill template here — feel free to copy into the one-pager: 

---
CUSTOMER PREFLIGHT — HOTLIST CHECK (please fill)
- Account name:
- Primary contact (name / email):
- Critical API path / endpoint(s):
- Cache approach (prefix/response/shared KV):
- Cache TTLs (seconds) / headers observed:
- Cache hit % (last 7d):
- Typical batch_size configured (min/max):
- Streaming enabled? (yes/no):
- p95 latency (ms) last 24h:
- Error rate (4xx/5xx) % last 24h:
- Notable config changes in last 14d:
- Top 3 critical flows (examples):
---

Rafael Cruz: Sample validation snippets for engs: 

1) streaming curl test:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Prefer: streaming=1" \
  -d '{"input":"hello","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```

2) minimal config snippet they can paste to us:
```
{"cache_prefix":"user-123","cache_ttl_secs":300,"batch_size":8,"enable_streaming":true}
```

(Keep TTL and batch_size editable fields on the form.)

Jun Park: Add this ops advice: for short, repetitive prompts use prefix caching with TTL ~3600s and shared KV to boost hit rate. For bursty traffic, set autoscale burst and increase max_concurrency rather than very large batches.

Tess Nguyen: This is great. Jun + Sarai — can one of you turn the above into a one-pager (MD + printable PDF) we can attach to renewal playbooks? Goal: AMs can send it to customer engs as a pre-call ask. Target: EOD. @cs_ops_bot please create a feedback ticket so we can track completion and attach the final artifact. :memo:

cs_ops_bot: Ticket created: FB-8742 — "hotlist-preflight". Assigned to Rafael Cruz. :white_check_mark: 

Rafael Cruz: I'll own the first draft and attach sample graphs for cache hit + p95. Will send draft here in ~3h. :eyes:

Emi Sato: I'll prepare the curl + small reproducible test harness (node + python snippets) to drop into the repo.

Tess Nguyen: Awesome — thanks team. Once Rafael posts the draft, I'll route to AMs and PM for sign-off.
